description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the complete Steering Knuckle Rebuild Kit.
Get everything you need to completely rebuild your front-end Knuckles.
Comes with King Pins & Bearings!
DOES BOTH SIDES!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 4 – King Pins
Qty 4 – King Pin Bearings
Qty 4 – Shims for King Pins
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Oil Seals
Qty 2 – Steering Knuckle Felts
Qty 4 – Retainer Plate, Knuckle Oil Seal
Qty 4 – Cover Plate, Knuckle Oil Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
